bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · lost the 30-day average
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 失守 30 日均线

read.en: Nvidia fell 3.2% on Oct 14 to $221.30. It is below its 5-day ($227.2), 10-day ($231.6) and 30-day ($226.0) averages and above the rising 100-day ($214.5) and 200-day ($202.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is still above zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($243.0), and RSI is 44.
read.zh: 英伟达 10月14日下跌 3.2%，收于 $221.30。股价位于 5 日（$227.2）、10 日（$231.6）和 30 日均线（$226.0）下方，并在上行的 100 日（$214.5）和 200 日均线（$202.7）上方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$243.0），RSI 为 44。

read.en: The $223–226 support (30-day average, Oct 13 low) broke on the close; the day's low was $219.64. That zone is now first resistance, then $231.6 (10-day) and $243 (Oct 6 record and SAR). Support is $214.5 (tested five times since April, 100-day average), then $207–209 (Aug 24 and Sep 14 lows) and $202.7 (200-day). A close below $214 would open $208.
read.zh: $223–226 支撑（30 日均线、10月13日低点）收盘失守；当日低点 $219.64。该区域现为第一阻力，其次 $231.6（10 日均线）和 $243（10月6日纪录高点及 SAR）。支撑为 $214.5（4月以来五次测试、100 日均线），其次 $207–209（8月24日及 9月14日低点）和 $202.7（200 日均线）。若收盘跌破 $214，下一目标看 $208。

s.en: Tested five times since April; 100-day average
